## Flight Dynamics Services

Customized and cost-effective solutions

##### Flight Dynamics as a Service

Our Flight Dybamics as a Service (FDaaS) provides an all-in-one flight dynamics solution, covering **every orbit** and **mission phase** from mission analysis, to ground operations.

##### On-Ground Navigation Solutions

**NEMO** is Nautilus’ advanced software suite for automating mission design and navigation: _Home_ for Earth orbits, _Nexus_ for lunar missions, and _Journey_ for deep space missions

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/original/6a6da20a4df224395493ad9b422e99f9/image.png)

##### On-Board Navigation Technologies

Leveraging autonomous **radiometric/optical navigation** and **inter-satellite links**, Nautilus revolutionizes Collision Avoidance maneuvers and enhances satellite navigation efficiency.

##### Ground Testing Equipment:

**CubeDynA** supports closed-loop testing of CubeSat Attitude Determination and Control Systems (ADCS) for platforms ranging from 1U to 12U (with future support for up to 16U).

## Projects

Creating Impact, everyday

LUMIO MISSION

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/original/7dae083bce72d9bff4c2a5afbbf88fd0/Lumio-01.jpg)

Lunar Meteoroid Impact Observer (LUMIO) is an ESA CubeSat mission designed to observe, quantify, and characterize **meteoroid impacts** on the lunar farside by detecting impact flashes. Nautilus is responsible for the ground segment desing and **flight dynamics operations.** LUMIO is expected to be launched in 2027.

AEGIS MISSION

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/original/c6a6d18ff906aca3d49107a747a406c5/AEGIS-Tavola-disegno-1.jpg)

Asteroid Exploration mission for Geophysical Investigation and In-Situ analysis (AEGIS) is an ASI-funded mission marking Italy’s first autonomous asteroid exploration. As the prime contractor, Nautilus leads the project, taking responsibility for mission analysis, satellite guidance, navigation and control systems, as well as the ground operations segment.

ARES

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/original/811f396dc6bb2add103d25fa4568c09b/ARES-Tavola-disegno-1.jpg)

The ARES project aims to enable **high-accuracy** **autonomous landing** in some of the most demanding planetary environments—Enceladus and Mars. As the Prime Contractor, Nautilus contributes to this initiative by designing, implementing, and validating a **cutting-edge hybrid navigation system** based on multi-sensor fusion and real-time onboard processing.

OB-ASTRA

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/original/0637dba9c917ad710b1010eb1b0db26c/OB-ASTRA-Tavola-disegno-1.jpg)

The OB-ASTRA (On-Board Autonomous Space Traffic Risk Avoidance) focuses on the development of an innovative **onboard system for Autonomous Collision Avoidance**, enabling satellites to autonomously monitor their orbital environment, assess collision risks, and execute avoidance maneuvers without ground intervention.

ENHANCEMENT OF SARDINIA DEEP SPACE ANTENNA (SDSA)

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/original/27ded523214546df6e105207b12fea63/SDSA-Tavola-disegno-1.jpg)

Enhancement of the Sardinia Deep Space Antenna (SDSA) Capabilities is a project aimed at strengthening SDSA's capacity for Near Space and Deep Space missions. Nautilus contributes to this initiative by developing advanced Flight Dynamics software for Operations (FD OPC) and Research (FD RC), along with conducting technical and operational studies to support navigation and TT&C services.

HERMES

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/original/32768158bf6e6cf27f728e2fa06f62cf/HERMES-Tavola-disegno-1.jpg)

High Energy Rapid Modular Ensemble of Satellites (HERMES) is an ASI-funded mission demonstrating high-energy gamma-ray burst detection with a **constellation of CubeSats**. Nautilus supports this initiative by developing the **Flight Dynamics software** for the Mission Operations Center, enhancing precision and effectiveness of operations.

CUBEDYNA

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/original/8a58395896e1622204a8e2dc046789d1/CubeDynA-01-1-.jpg)

The 3DOF Attitude Control Air Bearing Facility(ADCS) is an ESA-funded project to develop a **new attitude control test facility**. As prime contractor, Nautilus is responsile for the development and assembly of the test bed. The facility is designed for the **ground testing of cubesats ADCS** supporting platforms up to 12U.

## Markets

Multiple applications, endless gains

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/iW=362&iH=203&oX=59&oY=0&cW=243&cH=203/a0a6bf3002fceffb8823cd7c8e69204d/LunarEconomy.jpg)

#### **Lunar Economy**

The lunar economy is a frontier of innovation and opportunity. With our flight dynamics capabilities, we enable multiple lunar applications such as: **logistics, proximity operations, ISRU, communication, scientific experiments** and more in the lunar orbit and surface.

[Discover](https://www.spacenautilus.com/en/#a5TuM0RRmyp7)

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/iW=242&iH=282&oX=0&oY=39&cW=242&cH=204/43f0a5f08828fce6cc364051bfadfd18/image.jpg)

#### **Space Exploration**

Unlock the mysteries of the cosmos with our groundbreaking solution, granting satellites **unprecedented access to deep space** for exploration and research. Embrace financial sustainability, dare to venture beyond the stars, and shape the future of space exploration.

[Discover](https://www.spacenautilus.com/en/#vnvgJZoFFfVH)

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/iW=363&iH=204&oX=0&oY=0&cW=242&cH=204/25fc9f769c0a6b3a61d9342669dbe550/image.jpg)

#### **Asteroid Mining**

Asteroids contain a wide range of finite-Earth resources like **water or platinum**. Our cost-efficient solution can pave the way to enormous environmental and economic gains as well as provide critical resources to permanent human colonies in space.

[Discover](https://www.spacenautilus.com/en/#pwfz9Ocrbvuc)

### Planetary Defence

While the chances of a major near-Earth object collision are low in the near term, it is likely that in the far future humanity must face such a threat. Our solution will expedite SmallSats employment to study hazardous asteroids and eventually redirect their orbit.

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/iW=210&iH=245&oX=0&oY=57&cW=210&cH=132/a52d3e4e593f7dd2c7caf8926b107051/image.jpg)

### Space Exploration

The SmallSats revolution has enabled this class of spacecraft to self-sustain interplanetary scientific missions. Our solution will drastically increase access to deep space, allowing hundreds of SmallSats to explore our solar system and reveal its secrets.

![](https://cloud-1de12d.becdn.net/media/iW=235&iH=132&oX=0&oY=0&cW=210&cH=132/90f21cebd545b16ede9e798190eff7b9/image.jpg)

### Asteroid Mining

Asteroids contain a wide range of finite-Earth resources from water to platinum. Our cost-efficient solution can pave the way to enormous environmental and economic gains as well as provide critical resources to permanent human colonies in space.
